description: Ship the bundled codeagent-wrapper and Antigravity prefer-wrapper-then-degrade-to-agy collab path.
changelog:
**Enhancements:**
- feat(channel): bundle `bin/codeagent-wrapper.mjs` with the package and prefer any usable wrapper (CCG on disk/PATH, else the bundled one), degrading to a direct `agy` call when the wrapper is absent or fails.
- chore(cli): bump to 0.6.12 because 0.6.11 was already on npm without `bin/codeagent-wrapper.mjs` and could not be republished.

**Continuity note:** the published tarball did not bundle a migration manifest. No filesystem migration was shipped in this package.
